# Halow Freight

Halow Freight specializes in RecallSync, a dental clinic scheduling and billing tool aimed at optimizing chair utilization and insurance claim management. RecallSync seamlessly integrates recall campaign messaging across email, SMS, and phone channels, enhancing patient re-engagement for dental marketing solutions providers.

Our primary customers are dental marketing agencies seeking to boost patient recall rates and streamline communication workflows. In recent beta testing with select clinics, RecallSync achieved a 30% higher patient response rate compared to traditional outreach methods, demonstrating clear efficacy.

Founded eighteen months ago, Halow Freight completed a $2.5 million seed round led by Apex Ventures Dental Fund, fueling product development and market expansion. Our team includes dental industry veterans, software engineers, and data analysts focused on healthcare compliance and user experience.

Key competitors include OrthoReach and SmilePulse, which offer partial communication tools but lack RecallSync’s multi-channel integration and analytics depth. Open risks involve navigating complex insurance claim regulations and scaling customer support as we grow.
